80733.subject: Stop risking your work every time you use AI
80733.body:
AI Frontier

Автор: Steve Nouri

https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/stop-risking-your-work-every-time-you-use-ai-steve-nouri-66vjc?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BHdMoQpFTRfyE%2BCclMaBTig%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3krGnCoO3XIIs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mv6g5sm9~1d-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mv6g5sm9-1d
  
#IBMPartner  Most CIOs I've talked to this quarter say the same two things in one breath.  Their teams have never shipped faster, and they have never been this close to  losing something they can't get back.  Picture the fastest engineer you have ever hired.   Now give them the production keys on day one, no memory of last week's  decisions and total confidence in every command they run. That is what an AI  agent with broad access looks like.   On a normal Tuesday, it saves the team a week. On a bad one, it decides the  quickest fix for a failing migration is to drop the customer table and rebuild it,  and the backup nobody has tested turns out to be three months old.  The scenario is hypothetical, but the numbers underneath it come from IBM's  2026 Cost of a Data Breach Report, built on 602 breached organizations. built on  602 breached organizations.   The average breach now costs $4.99 million. One in four malicious breaches  were AI-enabled, up 56% in a year. More than 20% of companies reported a  breach that targeted their AI models or applications. This is the kind of problem IBM built Sovereign Core for, the first solution of its  kind for provable governance.   In easy terms, three things change:  Your models and inference run entirely inside your own boundary, and  you hold the encryption keys.  Your team operates the control plane, so configuration and lifecycle  stay in your hands rather than a vendor's.  Compliance is monitored in real-time with proof on-demand, so  evidence is always within reach.  The other half of the risk is getting stuck. Once your data and models live in  one provider's format, leaving gets expensive, and regulators have noticed.  Under the EU Data Act, cloud providers must let customers switch with their  data intact, and from January 2027 they can no longer charge for the exit.  Sovereign Core is open and hybrid by design, so your data and models move  freely between public cloud, private cloud and on-prem, and no single  provider can trap you.  What surprised me was the speed. It ships as a pre-configured stack, so a  secure AI environment stands up in under a day instead of being built from  scratch.   That is the trade those CIOs want: faster, without handing over the keys.
